layout: row-major, row 0 is the north edge (smallest z), column index grows with +x, row index with +z

start.heading_convention: radians; 0 faces -z (north); positive turns towards -x (anticlockwise seen from above, as three.js rotation.y); forward = (-sin h, 0, -cos h)

causeway.note: neck of land between water on both sides, south-west of the island, running roughly north to the island from the south bank

method.ground: site ground 0.5 m; unseen land, land below the lake, spikes over 0.5 m above a 10.5 m median and bank readings above min(2.5, 0.4 + 0.4 x distance to water) m refilled by a harmonic fill; bilinear to 0.25 m; Gaussian sigma 0.35 m; land floored at y = 0.03; mangrove islets capped at y = 0.30
method.bed: water cells: y from -0.06 at the shore, -0.36 at 1.5 m, easing to -1.20 by 7 m from land; under the fringe and under canopy the bed is held no deeper than -0.36, easing back over 2.0 m outside
method.thicket: 0-1 m and 1-2 m bands both present; opened with a 0.50 m radius disk, closed 0.25 m, cleared 0.35 m beyond each landmark stem collider, blobs under 3.0 m2 touching a stem dropped, blobs under 1.5 m2 dropped, holes under 1.0 m2 filled, never on bare cells
method.walkable: island, causeway and a 3 m radius landing on the bank, minus thicket, opened by 0.25 m, 4-connected component holding the start
method.canopy: 0.25 m canopy height where mapped, else 0.5 m site vegetation height (below 0.5 m read as none); 0 on open water, and blobs under 3.0 m2 standing mostly on water (reflections) dropped
method.classes: island = land polygon minus causeway; fringe = crop outline minus island, causeway and bank; water = water beneath (open or under canopy) plus unseen lake; mask bits are exclusive except thicket, walkable and fringe
